supported_scope: Weekes v2 Proposition 3.1 and Remarks 3.3-3.4 support dressed positive/negative subset generation, including loops and multiple arrows, without dividing by rotation.
The source gives a polynomial norm-induction proof of the unlocalized invariant Laurent model, conditional on its geometric BFN localization and minuscule formula.
Coefficient surjectivity to the full-charge quotient follows algebraically from nonzero-charge subset generation.
The grading comparison needed for the cut application is the charge-zero BFN grading, not an assumed nonnegative grading on the entire Coulomb algebra.
remaining_gaps: The old inventory does not independently establish the injective coefficient-preserving BFN embedding, Euler-factor conventions, and charge-zero grading interface used in prop:laurent-model.
Weekes Section 1.6.1 discusses enlarging flavor with minor changes; the full arbitrary-commuting-flavor parameter-retaining interface still needs independent verification.
C_LAURENT had an inconclusive historical judgment; C_CUT_SYMBOL@4 retains INPUT_LAURENT and abstract coefficient generation alone does not discharge it.
The old manuscript reference is a symlink to the current versioned source, not an independently frozen historical source copy.
